interest: Reveals Japanese perspectives on occupation legal authority, Formosan status, and debates over restoring jurisdiction over foreign nationals.
keywords: Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers (SCAP)
overview: This file documents deliberations between the U.S. State Department, SCAP, the Department of the Army, and the Japanese government from May to October 1949 regarding the restoration of judicial jurisdiction to Japanese courts. It centers on an extensive Japanese Foreign Office study on occupation legal directives, damage claims, and the status of Formosans, alongside emerging proposals and draft Far Eastern Commission policies to grant Japanese courts criminal and civil jurisdiction over non-occupation United Nations nationals.
